geometry_source.meaning: Existing project PnP feature-point span; not a verified measurement of the new screen outline.
geometry_source.selection: User requested existing dimensions and explicitly excluded large panels.

assumptions: Only the existing small-armor PnP dimensions, 135 x 56 mm, are used. No large panels are generated.
Applying the old feature-point span to the new screen is a modeling assumption, not a verified outer-screen measurement.
Glyph scale/placement, LED grid and surface appearance remain unverified hypotheses.
Four corners are projections of a plane with the existing small-armor geometry.
Glyph silhouettes are reconstructed from the supplied video; all LED radiance pixels are newly rendered.
Synthetic test holds out a 48-row grid, but shares glyph silhouettes and is not a real-world evaluation.
